import pandas as pd

file_path = '/data/asha_ngo_finances_FY25-26.xlsx'
xls = pd.ExcelFile(file_path)
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)

funding = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Funding')
print(funding)

# Compute gap
funding['gap'] = funding['Committed FY25-26 (INR)'] - funding['Received to date (INR)']
print(funding[['Funder','Committed FY25-26 (INR)','Received to date (INR)','gap']])
largest = funding.loc[funding['gap'].idxmax()]
print("Largest gap funder:", largest['Funder'], largest['gap'])
